extraRules: Base is master 89223b7 (later than the plan was written): codex-hooks Tasks 1-4 are merged (SessionStart, hook install --client codex, just codex-smoke), plus hub-notices, prefs T1-4, DB compaction T1-4, R2 T1-2, the web/TUI stale-after-ack fixes and the launcher. Rebase-check every cited signature (hookRun, hookState, usageText, src/daemon.ts startDaemon, ledger/KeyValue/Clock/Log types, launcher Tasks 6/8/9/11/17 surfaces) against this base and record drift as a deviation.

Build box: x-boss for every Go/Node/TS command (`BB_HOST=x-boss BB_JOBS=4 just bb ...`; TypeScript via `just bb bash -c 'just ln-setup && just ln-test <files>'` or `... && just ln-check'`). This overrides any other host in the plan. Never build or test on xsm. Only gofmt, git, just isa-check and go list run locally.
No migrations, no new Go dependencies, no edits to internal/hub/**, internal/store/**, internal/events/**, internal/mcpserver/** or internal/ui/** (other builds own them).
Coordinator rulings may appear in the statusDir decisions files; read them as the workflow instructs.

Known full-suite load flakes: internal/store TestTxImmediateSerialises and internal/hub TestBackfillRealReaderCheckpointPressure. If one is the only failure, rerun just that test with -count=3; if it passes, treat the suite as green and record it.

lensFocus.spec: This branch implements docs/plans/2026-11-04-codex-appserver.md Tasks 1-6 including all eight amendment items at the top of the plan (per-delivery eligibility, replayable release via AppCursor/Replay, crash-safe claim nonce, checkpoint-settled receipts, waiting_input dormancy, positive context canary in the smoke, identity pin --expect-hub/--expect-caller, canonical codex_home). The live smoke is intentionally not run.
lensFocus.security: Peer text stays inert in the stub prompt (hostile goldens byte-identical). The connector never answers approvals or questions, never changes policy/collaborationMode, refuses group/world-readable bindings files, enforces the per-home binding limit on canonical paths, refuses claims on hub/caller mismatch, and never touches real ~/.codex or Max's sessions in tests.
lensFocus.tests: Every named plan test exists and fails without its fix; fake app-server covers idle, mid-turn, approval-pending, waitingOnUserInput, crash/restart claim recovery and replay; tests never touch real ~/.config/vecnet, ~/.codex or a real daemon.
